promptTemplate: Create an image of the dish: {name}, in a homely Indian setting, served in a normal bowl or dish placed in an Indian kitchen or on a dining table. Focus on the food—the dish is the hero. Suggested garnishing is optional.
framing: Show one dish only in a close, food-focused frame. The named dish must be clearly visible and recognizable.
look: Natural household presentation, realistic food texture and soft natural light. The result should feel achievable in a family kitchen, not styled like a luxury restaurant.
avoid: text, lettering, labels, logos or watermarks
invented dishes or ingredients not named in the meal
